title: When Single Agent Is Enough: Rethinking Multi-Agent Systems for Automated Code Review
abstract: arXiv:2611.23283v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Code review plays a critical role in identifying software quality issues and ensuring system robustness. Prior work has proposed techniques for Review Comment Generation (RCG) and Code Refinement (CR), with recent Multi-Agent (MA) approaches achieving state-of-the-art results by coordinating agents specialized in different quality dimensions. However, MA systems introduce substantial architectural complexity and runtime overhead, and recent evidence suggests they may underperform Single-Agent (SA) approaches in certain tasks. In this work, we systematically compare MA and SA designs for RCG and CR. Surprisingly, our results show that SA approaches perform comparably to- and sometimes outperform-MA systems, despite their simpler design. These findings challenge the prevailing assumption that MA architectures are the default choice for complex software engineering tasks.

translated_title: 单智能体何时足够：重新思考用于自动化代码审查的多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 代码审查在识别软件质量问题和确保系统健壮性方面发挥着关键作用。先前的工作已经提出了审查意见生成（RCG）和代码改进（CR）的技术，近期的多智能体（MA）方法通过协调专注于不同质量维度的智能体取得了最先进的结果。然而，多智能体系统引入了大量架构复杂性和运行时开销，且近期证据表明它们在某些任务中可能表现不如单智能体（SA）方法。在本工作中，我们系统地比较了用于审查意见生成和代码改进的多智能体与单智能体设计。令人惊讶的是，我们的结果表明，尽管设计更简单，单智能体方法的表现与多智能体系统相当，有时甚至超越多智能体系统。这些发现挑战了多智能体架构是复杂软件工程任务默认选择的普遍假设。
tldr: 该论文通过系统比较发现，更简单的单智能体方法在代码审查任务中的表现与多智能体系统相当甚至更优，挑战了多智能体架构是复杂软件工程任务默认选择的普遍假设。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares multi-agent and single-agent designs for code review, showing that simpler single-agent approaches perform comparably to or even outperform multi-agent systems, challenging the prevailing assumption that MA architectures are the default choice for complex software engineering tasks.
